asset.name: Citation
asset.description: The compact source reference carrying state, confidence or relevance metadata, preview affordance, navigation to source, and grouping when several support one claim.

requires.reason: Reference markers use shared compact treatment.
Navigation to source uses shared link semantics.

suggests.reason: Inline inspection needs a preview surface; a reference list may simply navigate.

rationale: Confidence must be visible on the reference itself. A citation rendered identically whether it strongly supports a claim or merely mentions it makes sourcing decorative.
